keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «키커의 왼쪽 바퀴가 부러졌다(문제)» 와 «똑똑한 협동은 크기와 속도도 이길 수 있다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Kicker's left wheel broke) and the lesson (smart teamwork can beat size and speed). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why did Jiho's team want to give up?
qs.qko: 지호네 팀은 왜 포기하고 싶어 했나요?
opts: They were losing, and Kicker's wheel broke.
evs: Kicker was small, but it could pass the ball perfectly.
Then a big problem happened: Kicker's left wheel broke!
why: 전반전에 0대 3으로 지고 있었는데, 키커의 왼쪽 바퀴까지 부러졌어요. 그래서 팀원들이 포기하고 싶어 했어요.
They were losing three to zero, and then Kicker's left wheel broke. That is why the team wanted to give up.

qs.q: "Their teamwork confused Titan's big robot." What does "confused" mean here?
qs.qko: "Their teamwork confused Titan's big robot."이라고 나와요. 여기서 "confused"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: made the robot not know where the ball would go
evs: They changed the program so Kicker stayed in the middle and passed to the other robots.
Titan's robot was huge, fast, and very strong.
In the last minute, the score was four to three!
Jiho and his team built a soccer robot named Kicker for the school championship.
why: 키커가 가운데에서 다른 로봇들에게 계속 패스했어요. 공이 이리저리 움직이니까 큰 로봇은 공이 어디로 갈지 몰라 헷갈렸어요.
Kicker stayed in the middle and kept passing to the other robots. The ball moved so much that the big robot did not know where it would go.

qs.q: Why could Kicker still help the team after its wheel broke?
qs.qko: 바퀴가 부러진 뒤에도 키커가 팀을 도울 수 있었던 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: It could still pass well, so they changed the program to use passing.
Team Titan gave them a new wheel.
Kicker became bigger than Titan's robot.
evs: Kicker was small, but it could pass the ball perfectly.
By halftime, Team Titan was winning three to zero.
They changed the program so Kicker stayed in the middle and passed to the other robots.
Titan's robot was huge, fast, and very strong.
why: 키커는 작지만 패스를 완벽하게 할 수 있었어요. 그래서 팀은 키커가 가운데에 머물며 패스하도록 프로그램을 바꿨어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
Kicker was small but could pass perfectly. So the team changed the program to keep Kicker in the middle and pass. Put these two clues together.

ends: Jiho's team fixes Kicker and plays a friendly match with Team Titan.
지호네 팀이 키커를 고치고 타이탄 팀과 친선 경기를 해요.

write.src: “If <u>we work together</u>, we can <u>beat a stronger team</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «어떤 상황 + 그때 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write a situation and what we can do then in English.

chips.b: play better at the next game
chips.label: practice

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을, «we can» 뒤에는 동사를 바로 쓰세요. (예: If we pass the ball, we can score a goal)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what. After «we can», write a verb. (e.g. If we pass the ball, we can score a goal)

img.cover: On a small green robot soccer field in a school gym, a small round white robot with one green light eye and little black wheels sits in the middle and passes a ball to two other little robots, while a huge shiny red robot spins in confused circles, and a boy with spiky black hair and black glasses in a blue team T-shirt jumps and cheers behind the field.

scenes.1: On a small green robot soccer field, a small round white robot with one green light eye and little black wheels tilts to one side with one of its wheels lying beside it, while a boy with spiky black hair and black glasses in a blue team T-shirt and his teammates kneel next to it with worried faces and a huge shiny red robot stands tall nearby.
scenes.3: In a school gym with colorful streamers, a boy with spiky black hair and black glasses in a blue team T-shirt lifts a big gold trophy with his teammates, while a small round white robot with one green light eye and little black wheels sits proudly on the table beside them and a huge shiny red robot claps its big metal hands.
